name: dnaa-4-autoregulation
title: DnaA negative autoregulation — self-stabilizing the DnaA pool without the V override

seeded_from.reason:
Builds directly on the ADOPTED active box-binding (PR #162). DnaA's binding to
its own promoter (the 2 dnaA-promoter boxes) is now modeled + emitted — that
occupancy is the feedback signal autorepression needs.

question:
Can DnaA negative autoregulation hold the DnaA pool self-stabilized in the
literature [300,800] band across generations WITHOUT the manual V override
(Mechanism A) — by wiring DnaA-ATP repression of its own promoter into the
transcription recruitment (synth_prob = basal + delta_prob × dnaA-promoter
occupancy) — and does this dissolve the dnaa-1/dnaa-2 V tension (0.8e-3 vs 1e-3)
and the per-gen drift at their root?
background:
VERIFIED gap (2026-06-10): the runtime recruitment IS dynamic
(transcript_initiation: p_i = max(0, basal_i + Σ delta_prob[i,j]·bound_TF_j)),
but the dnaA promoter has NO DnaA-ATP recruitment edge — target_tf[TU00259[c]]
= None and delta_prob[TU00259[c], MONOMER0-160] = 0 — so no feedback path
exists, and the V override additionally replaces the dnaA synth prob outright.
A naive post-hoc patch FAILED (DnaA collapsed to ~17; basal didn't propagate +
no edge to carry the signal). FIRST DIAGNOSTIC (2026-06-10): in the adopted
box-binding run the dnaA-promoter boxes ARE occupied and vary (mean 1.41/2,
range 0.5-2.0) — so the feedback signal exists and option (b) is viable.
mechanism:
Wire a NEGATIVE DnaA-ATP → dnaA-promoter (TU00259[c]) recruitment edge so the
dnaA synth prob is modulated DOWN as DnaA occupies its own promoter. Two sources
for the bound-fraction:
  (a) the standard recruitment TF machinery (p_promoter_bound for DnaA-ATP) —
      cheapest test; must force the edge to survive the ParCa L1 fit;
  (b) PRINCIPLED — drive it from Rashmi's adopted dnaA-promoter box occupancy
      (promoter_high_bound), unifying box-binding with regulation. Preferred,
      and the first diagnostic shows the signal is present.
Calibrate basal (max unrepressed rate) + repression strength (anchor on the
−2.31 log2 FC ≈ 5×) so the feedback equilibrium lands DnaA in-band. Drop the V
override for this study.

variants.name: basal-x-strength-sweep
variants.description:
2-D calibration — basal (max unrepressed dnaA synth) × repression strength —
to find the combo whose feedback equilibrium holds DnaA in [300,800].

variants.name: signal-source
variants.description:
(a) standard TF p_promoter_bound for DnaA-ATP vs (b) coupled to the adopted
dnaA-promoter box occupancy. Diagnostic confirmed (b) has a usable signal
(occupancy mean 1.41/2, range 0.5-2.0).

model_settings.name: autorepression-edge
model_settings.detail: DnaA-ATP→TU00259 negative recruitment edge: synth_prob = basal + delta_prob × dnaA-promoter occupancy; restored from the −2.31 log2 FC, forced to survive the L1 promoter fit.

model_settings.name: repression-signal-source
model_settings.detail: dnaA-promoter occupancy from the adopted box-binding listener (promoter_high_bound) drives the bound-TF fraction (option b).

model_settings.name: no-V-override
model_settings.detail: No genetic_perturbations on TU00259[c] — the feedback sets the dnaA level (vs the fixed V override in dnaa-1/dnaa-2).

readouts.name: total DnaA pool
readouts.notes: Does it SELF-STABILIZE within [300,800] WITHOUT the V override? (the core test)

readouts.name: per-generation DnaA drift
readouts.identifier: per-gen mean of total DnaA across the lineage
readouts.notes: Does feedback flatten the fixed-V ramp (which went 73→880 at V=1e-3)?

readouts.name: dnaA-promoter occupancy → synth prob (the feedback loop)
readouts.notes: The repression signal and the synthesis it modulates — the autoregulation loop itself.

readouts.name: oriC count + cell mass
readouts.notes: Cell-cycle integrity — oriC 1↔2, periodic mass-doubling, preserved under feedback.

readouts.name: dnaA initiation rate
readouts.notes: STRETCH — does feedback hit ~1/min AND keep the pool in-band (no constitutive V did both)?

planned_runs.name: autoreg-feedback-no-V
planned_runs.n_steps: ~8 generations (succinate, seed 0, on the adopted box-binding cache)
planned_runs.details: Wire the autorepression edge + drop the V override → does DnaA self-stabilize in [300,800] via feedback?

planned_runs.name: basal-strength-calibration
planned_runs.details: Find the (basal, strength) combo whose feedback equilibrium lands DnaA in-band; confirm on a full 8-gen run.

simulation_set.name: autoreg-feedback-no-V
simulation_set.base_model: v2ecoli baseline + adopted box-binding + autorepression edge

config.title: PLANNED (mockup until the run lands) — DnaA pool over generations under feedback-controlled synthesis (no V override) vs the fixed-V drift, with the [300,800] band; plus dnaA-promoter occupancy (repression signal) and the resulting dnaA synth prob (the feedback loop). The test of whether autoregulation self-stabilizes DnaA and dissolves the V tension.

tests.name: dnaa-pool-self-stabilizes-in-band-no-V
tests.criterion: DnaA pool stays WITHIN [300,800] across ≥6 generations with NO V override (the thing a constitutive V could not do steadily).

tests.name: per-gen-drift-reduced-vs-fixed-V
tests.criterion: per-generation DnaA mean drift is reduced vs the fixed-V runs (which ramped 73→880 at V=1e-3).

tests.name: cell-cycle-preserved
tests.criterion: oriC 1↔2, one initiation per generation, periodic mass-doubling — preserved under feedback.

tests.name: closes-the-v-tension-stretch
tests.criterion: STRETCH — holds the in-band pool AND the ~1/min dnaA init rate simultaneously (no constitutive V achieved both — the dnaa-1 tension).

report.title: dnaa-4 — DnaA negative autoregulation (self-stabilizing the pool)
report.objective:
Make dnaA transcription feedback-controlled (autorepression via dnaA-promoter
occupancy) so the DnaA pool self-stabilizes in-band without the manual V
override, and test whether this dissolves the dnaa-1/dnaa-2 V tension + drift.

next_action:
1. Confirm the cheapest wiring: add the DnaA-ATP→TU00259 negative recruitment
   edge in ParCa (forced to survive the fit), calibrate basal, drop V, run →
   does DnaA self-stabilize? 2. If the standard TF bound-fraction stays ~0,
   couple the repression directly to the adopted dnaA-promoter box occupancy
   (option b — signal confirmed present). 3. Calibrate the 2-D basal×strength
   sweep to land in-band; check the ~1/min rate stretch goal.
